Name: Fluffy Puffball Cats
Author: SaturnCaturn
Description:
[size=5][b]They're so fluffy![/b][/size][size=4]
[/size]
[size=3]
Choose which cats you would like to add to your game and they will be added as new breeds, making them available to choose at the start of your game, or for purchase from Marnie!
They also become available through Alternative Textures then, but if you JUST want the textures, there's a standalone AT version as well. =)


[b]How to choose your preferred cats:[/b][/size][size=2]
[/size][size=3]
1. Install the CP version
2. Run the game once to create a config.json file
3. Edit the config.json and put the cats of your choice under "AddedCats"

[b]The options are:[/b] ColorPointBlue, ColorPointPink, ColorPointPurple, ColorPointYellow, CowBlue, CowChocolate, CowPink, CowPurple, CowYellow, TabbyBlue, TabbyGreen, TortieGreen, TortiePink, TortieYellow, Tortitude, TuxBlue, TuxGreen, TuxPink, TuxPurple, Vitiligo[/size][size=2]

[/size][size=3]Feel free to just copy that into your config, if you want all of them. Only three are added by default, so as not to clutter people's menus, but you can pick as many or as few as you want. =)
I've also included reference pictures.


The angry one is dedicated to my friend who has recently been a big fan of cats that seem to wear a constant scowl. :D

I might make a version with realistic coat colors as well, we'll see!

[/size][size=4]
Hope you enjoy![/size]
